name: nakama-research-dashboard
description: Research dashboard plugin for a self-hosted Nakama instance: one dashboard page plus five agent tools over shared coordination state (topics, development axes, evidence).

scripts.build: bun build ./src/actions.ts --outdir actions --target bun && bun build ./src/ui.tsx --outfile ui/app.js --target browser
scripts.check: bun run build && bun test src
